decided: Orbit keeps a copy of each change's brief when the change is archived, and of the program brief when the program's last change is archived, whatever the settings. When the user signs off or declines, the answer is recorded against that exact copy; a decline keeps the work waiting, records the user's reason, and the user says what happens next.
alternatives: keep a copy only when someone signs off
record a decline as a question for the next architect session instead of leaving the next step to the user
why: R-adf-7 asks for the brief in every mode, and tying the answer to the exact copy shows what the user read when signing.
